attempts.text:
Kakani temple and Suryagadhi school can't be reached. The only road linking Kakani temple to the rest of the network is damaged, and the school connects only to Kakani temple. Those 11 people have to be deferred, at a penalty of 490 (1 elderly × 50, 4 adults × 20 = 80, 6 children × 60 = 360).

Car1 can cover the reachable people alone. It takes the 3 elderly from Bidur care home (8 min out and 8 back), then the 4 elderly from Kalika temple (11 min out and 11 back). That is 38 minutes in total. Using car2 for Bidur would cost 44 minutes instead.

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter bidur-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 bidur-care-home uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
defer kakani-temple elderly 1
defer kakani-temple adult 4
defer suryagadhi-school child 6
</plan>

COST: 528
